notes: φιλοξενίαν is an accusative object, so the to of given to is the verb's own phrasal government and stays inside the participle's unit (rule 106's accusative arm), the article being unrepresented for want of a determiner (rule 23).
ταῖς and τῶν each take a written the with the case preposition riding along, headed on the (rules 17, 21), and ἁγίων stands bare behind its own article (rule 102).
